unsafe_justifications.justification: Test-only proof issuance accepts only three exact known fixtures and their exact combined-stream forms under default decimal and resource policies with a compatible wrapper. Complete strict cursor traversal validates syntax and budgets. Exact payload equality establishes the full frozen kind schema, required and optional membership, literals, unsigned integer values, sequence/trade ranges, symbol constraints, and every book element. Checked decimal parsing and level validation enforce prices, quantities, scales, precision and ticks before evidence is issued. Every StrRef uses a checked original-payload UTF-8 span and exact scalar count, book spans use complete original coordinates, decoded storage is empty, lengths are checked, and precisely these immutable owners and slots accompany the calculated fingerprint. Production profiles code contains no unsafe operations and never issues proofs.
